archetypes.name: step6-parity
archetypes.rationale: Step 6 shell parity depends on exact gate ordering and empty tmpdir behavior.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new Step 6 lifecycle functions against the retired shell behavior. Focus on pause ordering, sidecar authority, empty DESIGN_TMPDIR handling, in-flight guard predicates, and when sentinels are written. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: launcher-retirement
archetypes.rationale: The migration touches CLI registry, launcher routing, SKILL prose, migrated manifest rows, and deleted runtime files.
archetypes.prompt_body: Audit the Step 6 migration surfaces together. Verify the generated design-run launcher supports both retired basenames and bare verbs, structure pins match the edited strings, and deleted shell/debug files are fully represented in the retired manifest without stale runtime references. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
